START WITH YOUR KNOWLEDGE

“Where was that file?”Let’s move beyond that.

The documents exist, but finding them takes time. Questions pile up with the person who knows. Akarel helps make organizational knowledge useful in everyday work.

Grounded in your information.

Internal documents, policies, manuals and past materials. RAG—retrieval-augmented generation—provides a foundation for using your own information, beyond generic answers.

Built around the language of work.

Which information matters? What questions come up? We understand the work and help organize the knowledge and how people use it.

AI AGENTS

Task-specific AI agents

Combine organizational knowledge with workflows and decision rules. Research, summarize, draft and check. AI agents with roles tailored to specific tasks support everyday work.

en/dx-ai.html:
Skip to content

HANDS-ON DX & AI

Work alongside.Get our hands dirty.

Building a system is not the goal. We learn the reality of management and frontline work, then stay close until the business and the work itself become stronger and easier to move forward.

LISTENUNTANGLEMOVEHands-on DX & AI

REALITY FIRST.

Do not start with AI.
Do not start with a system.
Start with what is happening now.

You cannot see operational waste from a meeting room alone.

Those who lead.
Those who manage.
Those who do the work.

We listen to each, watch the work itself, and decide what should change.

Use AI when it helps.
Build a system when it helps.
Connect IoT when it helps.

But we do not build when it is not needed.

OUR PRINCIPLES

Three principles for
changing reality.

  1. 01

    Remove before you build.

    Do not digitize unnecessary work.

    Does this input need to exist? Why is this approval here? Why is the same information entered repeatedly?

    We first organize the work itself. Remove what can disappear, change what can change, then implement AI or systems only where needed.

  2. 02

    See numbers and strain.

    Operational KPIs alone do not change the frontline.

    We look beyond time, profit and cost to daily friction: searching, waiting, asking, transcribing and redoing.

    Less overtime. Fewer questions. Less concentration on veteran staff. Better business numbers.

    Do not reduce people.
    Reduce friction in work.
  3. 03

    Look beyond the screen.

    The frontline is not only inside a browser.

    Factories. Vehicles. Warehouses. Fields. Paper. Excel. LINE.

    That is why we do not think in web or generative AI alone. We combine AI, business systems, IoT and location intelligence for the reality of the work.

WHAT WE CAN HELP WITH

Choose the means
for the problem.

Sometimes changing a workflow or rule is enough. When technology is needed, we introduce it in a form the frontline can actually use.

INPUT & RE-ENTRY

Entering the same information again and again.

Review whether each input and approval is needed, then reduce remaining re-entry with existing tools and automation.

  • Process design
  • Tool integration
  • Automation

SEARCH & QUESTIONS

Asking someone whenever you need a document.

Organize where information lives and how it is shared, then use AI document search where it helps.

  • Knowledge organization
  • Search
  • AI

RECORDS & REPORTS

Management cannot see what is happening on site.

Review recording and reporting, using sensors or location data when needed to share information for decisions.

  • Operational improvement
  • Data integration
  • IoT

ABOUT FDE

Sometimes it is called
an FDE approach.

Forward Deployed Engineer.

It means entering a customer’s operation, understanding the challenge, implementing and staying involved until it is actually used. It is close to work we have long done.

But BonZuttner does not value an engineer visiting a site for its own sake.

Those who lead. Those who use. Those who build.
We help all three see the same problem. That is our accompaniment.

Management↕Field↕Technology

SELECTED WORKS

See the reality.
Then choose the technology.

A selection of our work.

CASE 01

Untangle complex work
with the frontline.

CASE 02

MEDICOM / WHOLESALE

Make everyday operations
stronger and smoother.

Reducing operational friction

CASE 03

WORKFLOW AUTOMATION / RPA

Free daily data entry
from manual work.

Excel integration × Browser automation

01 / 03

HOW WE WORK

Four moments
we move through together.

Not just in a meeting room. We work until daily work changes, choosing the means only after seeing the reality.

  1. 01

    Listen

    Hear the business aim and the voice of the frontline.

  2. 02

    Observe

    See the flow of work, information and friction together.

  3. 03

    Untangle

    Organize the challenge and decide what changes first.

  4. 04

    Move

    Combine AI, existing tools and operations until it sticks.

A GOOD PARTNERSHIP ENDS WELL

So that one day,
it runs without us.

We do not think accompaniment means creating a state where improvement is impossible without us.

Workflows.
Decision rules.
Prompts.
Manuals.
Source code.
Improvement history.

We leave what we build together as assets the customer can operate.

Everyday improvement stays inside. For the difficult parts, we work together again.

START WITH A CONVERSATION

Tell us about
the work on the ground.

“It is vaguely inconvenient, but we have always done it this way.”

That kind of work contains the seed of improvement. Whether to use AI comes later.

en/story.description: Why BonZuttner exists: our founding in 2019, the meaning of our name and three Re. words, and our belief in moving towards peace through everyday work.
en/story.html:
Skip to content

OUR STORY / WHY WE EXIST

Through work, toward peace.

We connect people’s skills, experience, and aspirations with meaningful work and opportunities to contribute to society. Through dialogue, understanding, and creating value together, we believe we can move closer to peace.

Where we began ↓
Re.

Rebuild. Recreate. Restart.

2019

OUR BEGINNING

Bridging talent and opportunity.

Our journey began when we met skilled Syrian IT professionals who faced barriers to employment and fair compensation because of displacement or where they lived.

At the same time, businesses in Japan and beyond needed specialized technology expertise. We saw an opportunity to connect skilled professionals with those needs while delivering value to customers. BonZuttner was founded in 2019 as a systems development company.

Work together. Create value together.

Read the story behind our founding ↗

THE NAME BONZUTTNER

Keep striving to do good.

Our name honors Bertha von Suttner, a peace activist and Nobel Peace Prize laureate. Her commitment to peace inspires how we act every day. Our name also draws on three linguistic elements.

Bertha von SuttnerBertha von Suttner

Bon
Good, excellentFrench
Zutt
ContinuouslyJapanese
Er
Someone who takes actionEnglish

Someone who continually strives to do good—and follows through with action.

WHY TECHNOLOGY

Working together across borders.

Who does this technology serve, and how can we use it responsibly?

Technology enables people in different places to bring their expertise together and deliver meaningful results. We chose this field to connect the skills of the people we met with work that addresses real needs in society.

AI can accelerate work and software development. But understanding business needs, designing reliable systems, and taking responsibility for quality, security, and ongoing operations still require professional expertise. We believe these skills will remain essential.

What we work on today ↗

OUR THREE “RE” PRINCIPLES

A new beginning for each person.

No one should be defined solely by displacement or nationality. Every person has a name, skills, character, and aspirations. Through meaningful work, we aim to create more opportunities for people to shape their own futures.

· ·

Rebuild.

Rebuild connections

Build a new life in a new environment and reconnect with others.

OUR ATTITUDE

🥄.

A sincere approach,with a dash of humor.

Oops. A little too much.

MEET BONZUTTNER

Putting our beliefs into action.

What could we achieve together, and who would you work alongside? Explore our services and meet the people behind BonZuttner.

START WITH THE WORK

ja/dx-ai.html:
本文へ

DX・AI活用伴走

一緒に、汗をかく。

システムをつくることが目的ではありません。経営や現場の実態を知り、事業や仕事をより円滑に、また強くする。変化が根づくところまで、現場に入り込んで伴走します。

LISTENUNTANGLEMOVEHands-on DX & AI

REALITY FIRST.

AIから考えない。
システムから考えない。
まず、いまそこで起きていることを見る。

会議室だけでは、業務の無駄は見えません。

経営する人。
管理する人。
実際に手を動かす人。

それぞれの話を聞き、実際の仕事を見ながら、何を変えるべきかを考えます。

必要ならAIを使う。
システムを作る。
IoTをつなぐ。

でも、必要がなければ作りません。

OUR PRINCIPLES

現実を変えるための、
3つの原則。

  1. 01

    作る前に、なくす。

    不要な仕事まで、DXしない。

    「この入力、本当に必要ですか？」
    「この承認はなぜありますか？」
    「なぜ同じ情報を何度も転記していますか？」

    まず仕事そのものを整理します。なくせるものはなくす。変えられるものは変える。その上で必要な部分だけ、AIやシステムを実装します。

  2. 02

    数字と、しんどさを見る。

    経営KPIだけでは、現場は変わらない。

SATELLITE DATA × AGRICULTURE

宇宙の視点を、農業の判断に。

何を育てる？ 畑はいま、どんな状態？ 衛星画像に気候・土壌などの情報とAIを組み合わせ、農業の「どうしよう」を考える材料へ。

農業での活用を相談する畑に聞きたいこと

衛星と、畑の作戦会議。

ASK YOUR FIELD

この畑に、聞いてみよう。

知りたいことを選ぶと、分析の使いどころが見えてきます。

土地に合う作物を考える

CROP SUITABILITY

何を、どこで育てるか。

気候や土壌などの条件を、作物の特性と照らし合わせる。適地適作の検討に、広い範囲を見渡すデータを活かします。

  • 土壌

宇宙のデータ。現場の感覚。

小さく試して、現場で確かめる。

作物、土地、日々の気がかり。まだ何を分析すればよいか決まっていなくても大丈夫です。現場で知りたいことから、一緒に考えます。

ja/story.description: 2019年の設立、社名に込めた平和への願い、3つのRe.。一人ひとりの技術と経験を仕事につなぎ、日々の対話と協働を通じて平和へ進むBonZuttnerの物語。
ja/story.html:
本文へ

OUR STORY / WHY WE EXIST

仕事を通じて、平和へ進む。

一人ひとりが持つ技術、経験、願いを、仕事と社会につなぐ。対話し、理解し、ともに価値を生み出す。その積み重ねが平和につながると、私たちは信じています。

私たちの出発点へ ↓
Re.

再構築。再創造。再出発。

2019

OUR BEGINNING

才能と、仕事の間に。

高いITスキルがあっても、避難の経験や暮らす場所によって、働く機会や正当な対価に接続できない。そんなシリアの人たちとの出会いが、出発点でした。

一方で、日本をはじめ社会には、専門的な技術を必要とする現場がある。双方を仕事でつなぎ、お客様に価値を届ける会社をつくる。2019年、BonZuttnerはシステム開発会社として始まりました。

ともに働き、ともに価値を生み出す。

設立背景を紹介した取材記事 ↗

THE NAME BONZUTTNER

善き人に、なろうとし続ける。

社名には、平和活動家でノーベル平和賞受賞者のベルタ・フォン・ズットナーへの敬意を込めています。平和への願いを、日々の姿勢と行動につなげたい。その想いに、3つの言葉を重ねました。

ベルタ・フォン・ズットナーBertha von Suttner

Bon
よい、優れたフランス語
Zutt
ずっと日本語
Er
〜する人英語

善き人になろうとし続け、そのように行動する人。

WHY TECHNOLOGY

国境を越えて、ともに働ける。

技術を、誰のために、どう使うか。

ITは、離れた場所にいる人とも専門性を持ち寄り、成果を生み出せる手段です。出会った人たちの高い技術力と、社会が必要とする仕事をつなぐ。そのために、私たちはこの領域を選びました。

AIの力で、仕事や開発の速度を高める。さらに、業務を理解し、設計し、品質・セキュリティ・運用に責任を持つ。そうしたプロフェッショナルの価値は、これからも大切になると考えています。

今、取り組んでいること ↗

OUR THREE “RE.”

一人ひとりの、次の出発へ。

避難の経験も、国籍も、一人のすべてを表すものではありません。それぞれの名前、技術、性格、願いがある。私たちは、その人が未来を選び直せる機会を、仕事を通じて増やしていきたい。

Rebuild.

再構築

新しい生活や環境、そして人と人のご縁を結び直す。

OUR ATTITUDE

🥄.

真摯な姿勢を、ひとさじのユーモアと共に。

あ、入れすぎた。

MEET BONZUTTNER

この想いを、仕事にする。

私たちと、どんな仕事ができるのか。誰と仕事をするのか。サービスとメンバーから、今のBonZuttnerをご覧ください。
